manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
